title: Taiwan's Bold European Outreach: Vice President Hsiao's Diplomatic Visit to Belgium
description: Taiwan's Vice President Hsiao Bi-khim made a significant diplomatic visit to Belgium, marking a bold move to strengthen relations with Europe. Speaking at the European Parliament, Hsiao highlighted Taiwan's commitment to democracy. Taiwan continues to engage globally, despite China's disapproval of such interactions.

title: China’s new aircraft carrier signals naval ambitions
